question: What are the countries having confidence in national goverment higher than world average in 2022?
query: SELECT country_name, AVG(confidence_in_national_government) AS avg_confidence FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year = 2022 AND confidence_in_national_government > (SELECT AVG(confidence_in_national_government) FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year = 2022) GROUP BY country_name ORDER BY avg_confidence DESC LIMIT 50;
